dataList.content:
... What a mess.
……真是一团糟啊。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
When one thinks of an assembly, their brain might conjure the image of a forum for discussion, a place to hash out each other's differences with words...
所谓的会谈，便是为了解决什么问题而交换各自意见的场合……

... but that is a rare sight in this City.
但遗憾的是，这座都市里几乎不存在那样可靠的会谈。

There's no need to look very far for an example. This child is sitting in one.
不用去找例子，孩子现在注视着的会谈便是如此。

Let's get one thing straight. It's the Teppu Family's fuckups that caused the local merchants to jump ship. Yes, or no?
老实说，难道不是铁风会的失败导致了周围商人的离开吗？
dataList.teller:
Nekomata Mafia Henchman
猫又派 组员
dataList.title:
Nekomata Mafia
猫又派

dataList.content:
Fundamentally speaking, the Kurokumo Clan has the responsibility to pay a greater share of the tribute we send. They're raking it in with their 'protection' business, aren't they?
目前收了很多保护费的黑云会该再多承担一些奉纳吧……
dataList.teller:
Tepuu Family Henchman
铁风会 组员
dataList.title:
Tepuu Family
铁风会

dataList.content:
The Knots does not wish to be a part of this argument.
绳结派不打算插手这件事。
dataList.teller:
The Knots Henchman
绳结派 组员
dataList.title:
The Knots
绳结派

dataList.content:
My fault. Your fault. You should pay more. No, you should.
是谁的问题啦。又是谁该出更多的钱啦。

People sitting in a room hazy with cigarette stench, barking impractical, meaningless boasts at each other.
伴随着香烟的烟雾袅袅升起，人们用毫无意义的话语大声争论着。

The child looks at them with open exasperation.
面对那群人，孩子露出了厌烦的表情。

I am in agreement, but we are currently here in an official capacity—don't be so rash in your speech.
我也有同感，但在公共场合请你谨言慎行。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
I doubt those sods can hear us over that bloody racket.
反正那帮家伙互相间吵个不停，根本听不到我们说话吧。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
... How did it come to this?
……他们到底是怎么沦落到如此地步的。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
If you're so mad about it, go tell 'em yourself.
烦的话就去和他们说啊。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Have you forgotten? An overwhelming majority of the Syndicates that have gathered here are the Thumb's subsidiaries.
你难不成忘了这里聚集的大部分帮派都是拇指麾下的吗。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
I am but a Wakashu; I am in no place to talk, unless someone were to bestow me with the appropriate authority.
要让我这个若众出面，就必须有人将权威让渡给我。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
It seems that even Captain Ishmael... is unwilling to join the cacophony.
以实玛利副会长……也没有现在出面的意思。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
The Kurokumo Clan, the Syndicate the child was a part of, was not exactly in a great position among those present.
孩子所属的黑云会，在会谈中所处的地位实际上并不是很好。

The Patriarch had, after an unfortunate incident, excused himself for a moment. And the former Captain, who entered the Library, was never heard from again.
会长因为意外事故暂时缺席，前副会长进入了图书馆后失踪。

The only one with any degree of authority left was the newly—and hastily—appointed Captain.
只剩下匆忙填补那个空缺的新副会长。

Though she was technically the acting head of the Syndicate, an authority given by the Patriarch... it was inevitable that the other Syndicates would look down on them.
即使会长将权威让渡给她……他们依然会被其他帮派所轻视。

Well, I'm sure the lass can handle this.
啊。大概她会有些想法吧。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
... Your faith in the Captain seems to have grown since the last time we met.
……一段时间不见，你似乎更信任副会长了。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
You seemed to be bickering endlessly with her at the last assembly...
上一次会谈时，你们的关系看起来还很恶劣。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Can't say I'm on good terms with her, even now. But goin' out for drinks together helps mend some things, build rapport, and what have you.
现在也称不上关系好。但在每天吵架、一起喝酒的时候，我们至少能互相理解了。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
It's a bit of solidarity, innit? We've both wandered for a while before joining the Syndicate. We both have right bad bastards to get back at... see the picture?
我们在入会前都流浪过一阵子……也都有要复仇的家伙……某种程度上有种是同一类人的感觉。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
But I suppose that's no longer true, now that she outranks you.
但那已经结束了。因为她高升了。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Couldn't you have been a tad nicer about that jab...? Tsk.
你说话真是不中听……啧。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Oh, well. She does deserve to be up there.
哎。不过我确实觉得那家伙是该升上去的。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
I don't know what I'm doin' anymore. I remember making a promise with myself that I'd go back there as a successful man, a man of quality, but now... I'm not so sure. What was I doin' all this for, anyway? Why even go back?
我现在已经完全搞不懂了。虽然我曾经发誓……要衣锦还乡，但最近却不明白了。自己究竟是为了什么才那么想回去。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Someone once told me that... only people with a clearly defined goal get to the top. Like the lass.
有人曾对我说过……能爬到高处的，都是像那家伙一样有着明确目标的人。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Seems like a sensible sort, this 'someone' of yours.
虽然不知道是谁说的，但这话确实在理。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Yeah, bossman Matteo. Used to rely on him back at T Corp.
啊，是马泰奥大哥说的。我在T公司的时候曾经受过他一些照顾。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Oh. The assembly's breaking, I think?
哦，看来会谈结束了？
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Looks like we're just going in circles. Let's reconvene tomorrow.
看来我们很难达成共识。会议改到明天继续吧。
dataList.teller:
Nekomata Mafia Henchman
猫又派 组员
dataList.title:
Nekomata Mafia
猫又派

dataList.content:
... Agreed. We'll never come to an agreement at this rate.
……同意。这样下去没完没了了。
dataList.teller:
Tepuu Family Henchman
铁风会 组员
dataList.title:
Tepuu Family
铁风会

dataList.content:
Seconded.
好，就这么办吧。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
Heathcliff.
希斯克利夫。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
Huh? Whassit? Whisperin' all of a sudden...
嗯？怎么？怎么突然小声喊我……
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Make sure that the boys and girls stay on high alert tonight. Something's brewing.
让咱们的人在夜里做好准备，提高警惕。看样子，这次会谈不会风平浪静地结束。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
... You serious, lass?
……你认真的吗？
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
They've got to be a screw loose in the head to attack the Kurokumo Clan on our own turf.
如果不是吃了熊心豹子胆，是不可能敢在我们的地盘上袭击黑云会的吧？
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
... I got this feeling from the conversation that they're trying to hone in on one of our 'businesses'. Besides, they asked me where we were staying. Multiple times.
……我感觉有几个帮派盯上了我们的业务。而且反复打听我们的住处也很可疑。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
Huh. These crazy bastards. Fine, let 'em try. I'll tear their heads from their—
呵。真是帮疯子。要是被我逮到了，就让他们的脑袋都……
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
It's just a suspicion at the moment. Don't get too worked up yet. Anyways... I'm trusting you with this, okay?
还只是怀疑而已，先别那么激动。总之……这个就交给你了。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
Some time passes, and dark clouds shroud the moon in shadow.
时间流逝，来到了乌云密布的漆黑之夜。

The child's suspicions had been true...
孩子的怀疑成真了……

A few suspicious figures quietly stepped into the child's bedroom.
几个可疑的身影蹑手蹑脚地潜入了希斯克利夫的卧室。

They loomed over him for a moment before unsheathing their blades...
他们观察了一会儿孩子的状态，从怀中取出了一把小刀……

... and stabbed, aiming straight for the child's un-tattooed neck.
朝着没有纹身的脖子用力刺去。

She weren't kidding.
真来了啊？
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
But the blade could not break his skin.
但那刀刃并没有刺穿孩子的脖子。

Black tattoos, drawn over various parts of his body, quickly crowded around his neck like tufts of cloud...
纹在孩子身上各处的黑色纹身，瞬间如云般聚集在他的脖子上……

... and the sword, clashing with the tattoo, slid off harmlessly.
碰在纹身上的刀刃发出了尖锐的声响，弹了回来。

This ain't the first time, but... blimey, so that wasn't the end of it, yeah?
虽然每次都是让部下完成计划……但总感觉光是那样没法结束啊。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
What the hell? What is that—
怎么回事，没有这样的情……
dataList.title:
???
？？？

dataList.content:
Kurokumo Clan tattoos, lads. Your little knives won't work.
我们黑云会的纹身可不会被这样的刀给刺穿。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Or do you not have these where you're from?
或者说，你们的纹身好像不会动啊？
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
The child's own blade flashed in the dark and struck the assassin' in the neck, felling him to the ground.
孩子很快拔出刀反击，惊慌的袭击者毫无防备地被砍断了咽喉。

As soon as their death was confirmed, the child leaped from his bed and joined the others in the streets.
孩子在斩首了袭击者后，很快与同伴们一同冲向了外面。

There...
而在那里……

Weren't you the one who warned us to stay alert? How come you're the last to join us?
明明是你让我们待命的，却出来得最迟啊。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Was luring 'em in there, I don't want to hear your nagging about— nevermind. Anyways...
都说了因为我是诱饵啊……不，算了。比起那个……
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
... just how many of 'em are there?
这些家伙到底是什么人？
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
... More than we expected. More Syndicates were in on this alliance than we'd thought.
……勾结起来的帮派数量比想象中要多。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Various Syndicates had gathered in the streets to challenge the Kurokumo Clan.
有许多帮派聚集在街上，向着黑云会发起进攻。

Underestimating the Kurokumo Clan, eh? Bastards...!
这些家伙，把我们黑云会当成什么了……！
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
The Captain'll be here soon.
副会长马上就到。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
We just have to... hold out until she...
我们要在这里……撑到那时候……
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Nope.
不用。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Holding out ain't like the Captain... we'll fight our way through them.
硬撑可不是副会长的性子啊……得突围吧。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
I bet they're planning to go for the 'Showdown' with her, anyway.
反正他们会想通过“决战”一口气解决的。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
The Showdown.
决战。

Syndicates of the eastern region often employed this tradition when making important decisions.
东部的许多帮派在决定重要事务的时候，经常会使用单挑决斗制度。

Of course, losing or refusing did not result in consequences of any 'official' capacity...
当然，哪怕失败或者拒绝也并不会导致什么“实质上”的利益受损……

... in the eastern part of the City, where Showdowns have become a part of the culture. In a way, defeat often meant that the morale of the allies would be severely dampened.
然而在决战文化扎根的东部，那样的选项会让同伴的士气一蹶不振。

And... as morale was quite an important element in battles with high headcounts...
而且……在多人战斗中，士气是非常重要的因素。

Looks like we're gonna have to pave the way for her to accept their boss's challenge!
正因如此，我们必须开路到他们老大所在的地方！
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
... the child rushed forward, blade in hand.
孩子紧握刀柄，向前突进。

Weaker attacks glanced off his enhancement tattoos,
他信任着强化纹身，直接承受了一些不痛不痒的攻击，

as he focused on furiously cutting down the endless swarm of enemies.
孩子接着斩杀了一个接一个的敌人，向前推进。

But his powerful charge eventually came to a grinding halt.
但是，他的突进并没有长久持续下去。

The enemy Syndicate's boss had blocked his path.
看上去是前来袭击的帮派的老大挡住了孩子的前路。

Gah!
咳！
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
The child fought to the best of his abilities, but after having cut through countless enemies, he was exhausted.
虽然孩子全力战斗了，但对于已经精疲力尽的他来说，斩杀如此数量的敌人也并不简单吧。

One. Two. Three.
一下、两下、三下。

The child's form began to break with each clash...
随着不断的剑击，孩子摆出的架势也在逐渐崩溃……

... and when even the enhancement tattoos couldn't block their onslaught, the child fell to his knees.
而随着强化纹身也没法完全防御的伤口逐渐增加，孩子终于倒在了地面上。

Shite...
哈啊……
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
I... I'm almost there...
明明就快突围了……
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
And that's when...
就在那时。

Why didn't you wait? Just look at you. You're a mess.
你等着不就好了。真不像样啊。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
... light footsteps approached from behind him.
沉重的脚步声从他背后慢慢靠近。

... Oi, Captain.
……副会长。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
There was a shitload of 'em... Heh, I did quite alright considering the odds, didn't I?
他们人数多过头了……嘿。这么想来，我也算尽力了吧？
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
Oh, are we past giving a shit about respect, now? This is hardly the time to be facetious.
如今你擅自突围倒下了呢。这可不是开玩笑的时候。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
Yeah, whatever you say... If I zipped up and acted all serious, you would've scolded me for tryin' too hard to look cool.
可不好笑啊……就算我在这里扮严肃，也反倒会看上去傻兮兮的……还会被你骂的吧。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
True.
嗯，没错呢。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
... Just the same ol' lass, ain't ya.
……你还是老样子呢。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会

dataList.content:
His vision began to grow faint like gathering clouds under a clear sky, but her voice was coming through clear.
虽然孩子的视野仿佛被云翳遮蔽那般慢慢暗淡下去，但传入他耳中的声音依旧清晰可辨。

My name is Ishmael, thirty-fourth Captain of the Kurokumo Clan.
黑云会第三十四代副会长，以实玛利。
dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长

dataList.content:
She'd never lost a fight she began with that line.
用那句话开场的副会长，迄今为止还没有输过。

The child grinned with relief even as he felt his consciousness leave.
就连孩子倒地的那一瞬间，他的嘴角似乎还安心地咧开着。
